weights.why: initial guess: equal weights for damage and kill speed, half weight for accuracy, spotting and assists. Recalibrate once enough battles exist (same rule as the other configs).

slopeFloor.why: copied from the Ps2 Elite KD Brave/PVS definition (SLOPE_FLOOR) as a starting point; the WoT slope is a proxy, so this is not a fitted value

slopeEps.why: copied from the Ps2 Elite KD Brave/PVS definition (SLOPE_EPS); keeps the shifted slope positive

scale.why: team average of the score is 100 by construction, so a player's score reads as percent of the team average

skillMin.why: initial guess: lowest skill weight for a target (team-relative style score ÷ 100, clamped). Separate from the threat weight, which is not changed.

skillMax.why: initial guess: highest skill weight for a target (style score ÷ 100, clamped)
